node.statement: Let C_co^old and e_co be witnesses supplied by lem-compcb-rectangular-product, and set C_co:=max{C_co^old,0}. This replacement preserves the upstream estimate: since e>=0 and ||A||||B||>=0, C_co>=C_co^old implies C_co^old*e*||A||||B||<=C_co*e*||A||||B||, so ||A dot B-AB||<=C_co*e*||A||||B|| still holds for every compatible pair. Thus C_co is finite, universal, and nonnegative, and all occurrences of C_co in this proof may and shall denote this normalized witness.
